stories.title: My First PPC & Karnataka Philately Passport – Mysuru HO
stories.text:
On 11 October 2026, I visited Mysuru Head Post Office (#63), marking a special milestone in my Karnataka Philately journey.

This was the day I purchased my Karnataka Philately Passport at the same post office and received my very first Pictorial Cancellation (PPC).

It was more than just a visit to a post office. It was the beginning of my journey to explore Karnataka's post offices, collect pictorial cancellations, and preserve memories of every destination through philately.

I will always remember Mysuru HO as the place where my passport journey began and where I collected my first PPC.

One passport. One first PPC. Countless stories waiting to be discovered! 🇮🇳📮
